clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: "Services" means the services in Schedule A. "Fees" means the amounts set out in Schedule B.

clauses.heading: Services
clauses.text: Provider shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care.

clauses.heading: Fees
clauses.text: Client shall pay the Fees monthly in advance.

clauses.heading: IP and Confidentiality
clauses.text: All work product created under this agreement belongs to Client. Provider shall keep all Client data confidential.

clauses.heading: Insurance
clauses.text: Provider shall maintain liability insurance of at least 1,000,000 rupees.

clauses.heading: Subcontracting
clauses.text: Provider may not subcontract the Services without Client's written consent.

clauses.heading: Audit Rights
clauses.text: Client may audit Provider's records once a year on 14 days notice.

clauses.heading: Records
clauses.text: Provider shall keep accurate records of all Services for 5 years.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate on 60 days notice. Fees due under Clause 3 for work already done remain payable.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by Indian law.
